# Value types (Q_GADGET)

These are the objects the API hands back: `VescIf.getLastFwRxParams()` returns `FW_RX_PARAMS`, `Commands.valuesReceived` carries `MC_VALUES`, and so on. Their `Q_PROPERTY` members are readable in QML as normal properties. Enum-typed members (`mc_fault_code`, `HW_TYPE`) compare against the enum keys listed in `datatypes.h`.

Signatures use C++ types. In QML: `QString` is a JS string, `QVector<T>` and `QStringList` are JS arrays, `QVariantMap` is a plain JS object, `QVariantList` an array, `QByteArray` an `ArrayBuffer` (read with a `DataView`), and `QVariant` anything.

Generated from vesc_tool `a34c1727` (working tree dirty).
